description: Android privacy audit over adb: app permissions, endpoints inside each APK, data flows, and reversible fixes (no root).
notes: Needs adb (Android platform-tools) and a device with USB debugging enabled.
Run 'noir doctor' to check adb / jadx / device, or 'noir setup' to download adb and jadx into %USERPROFILE%\.noir\tools.
'noir' with no arguments starts the guided wizard; 'noir deep' and 'noir deepscan' additionally need jadx.
Endpoint cache and downloaded tools stay in %USERPROFILE%\.noir, reports go to .\noir-out, so both survive 'scoop update'.
